decision.observation: The farmer is standing in the farmhouse doorway at 7:40 a.m.; the exit transition has not triggered yet.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing down through the doorway will take the farmer outside, where the route east toward Pelican Town begins.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach. From the farm, travel east through the bus stop into Pelican Town, then take a southern route rather than continuing to the eastern riverbank. Passing out costs money.
